# English With Marcello

> Online English lessons with Marcello, a native English-speaking teacher from Toronto, Canada, based in Milan, Italy. Lessons are conducted entirely online in 50-minute sessions and are available to students worldwide at all levels, from true beginner (A1) to advanced (C2).

## About

Marcello is a native English speaker and a fluent Italian speaker, offering personalised one-on-one and group English lessons online. He learned Italian from scratch while living in Italy, so he understands the language learner's perspective and can support and explain in Italian when helpful. His teaching is tailored to each student's goals, level, and learning style.

Certifications: TESOL, TEFL, and TESL certified; IELTS and TOEFL exam-preparation certified.

## Lessons Offered

Lessons fall under four umbrellas:

- **Conversation** (levels B1–C2) — Spoken English with little focus on grammar itself. Covers casual everyday conversation as well as business and professional English (for example, meetings, presentations, job interviews, and speaking with clients). From €{{ site.data.pricing.conversation }} per 50-minute lesson.
- **Standard** (levels A1–C2) — Structured teaching of English grammar and vocabulary across the whole language, from the basics to the most advanced uses, broken into Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced. From €{{ site.data.pricing.standard }} per 50-minute lesson.
- **Exam Preparation** — Focused preparation for a specific exam. Specialised in IELTS and TOEFL; also experienced with Cambridge, Oxford, and CELPIP. Develops all four skills with strategies, practice tests, and personalised feedback. From €{{ site.data.pricing.exam_prep }} per 50-minute lesson.
- **Shadowing & Pronunciation** (levels B1–C2) — A distinct activity focused specifically on the shadowing technique and pronunciation, to improve accent, rhythm, and fluency. From €{{ site.data.pricing.shadowing }} per 50-minute lesson.

Lessons are available one-on-one; group lessons are also offered.

## Key Details

- **Format**: Online only (video lessons), 50 minutes per lesson
- **Levels**: All levels welcome — true beginner (A1) to advanced (C2)
- **Languages**: Teaches in English; also speaks Italian and can support beginners in Italian
- **Price**: From €{{ site.data.pricing.standard }} per 50-minute lesson (specialised Exam Preparation and Shadowing & Pronunciation from €{{ site.data.pricing.exam_prep }})
- **Location**: Based in Milan, Italy; teaches students worldwide
- **Booking**: Free trial lesson available at https://www.englishwithmarcello.com/bookings.html
